description:
Prepare for a completely new way of folding with DELTECH precision. The Jaws hinge is the next evolution in DAHON LockJaw technology. Seamless and sturdy teeth lock the hydroformed frame into place, while its 8 speeds and DAHON custom tires brace you for a powerful journey ahead.

Powered by DAHON-V

Featuring DELTECH and Super DownTube—key patents of DAHON-V technology—Launch D8 offers superior frame rigidity for outstanding speed and safety. This powerful synergy enhances pedaling efficiency, making even uphill rides a breeze.

Grip the World with Comfort

Featuring a comfortable adjustable ergonomic handlebar, the DAHON Launch D8 promotes a natural riding position, reducing strain on your back and shoulders for a more enjoyable cycling experience on long rides.

Saddle Up for Comfort

The plush saddle of the DAHON Launch D8 is designed for maximum comfort, featuring cushioning that absorbs shocks and reduces fatigue, allowing you to enjoy longer rides without discomfort

Durable and Efficient

Built from forged aluminum for lightweight durability, this crankset ensures reliable power output and efficient pedaling. The sleek design and protective guard enhance performance while keeping the components safe during your rides.

Master Your Ride

Conquer any terrain with the DAHON custom 8-speed drivetrain and DAHON Newton Double-brake, ensuring seamless gear changes and quick stops for ultimate control and safety.

Your Go-To Bike for Everyday Escapes

Turn your daily commute into an adventure with the Launch D8. Enjoy the freedom to cycle through urban landscapes while easily folding it up when you need to.

Launch Into Adventure with DAHON D8

The DAHON Launch D8 is your go-to folding bike for city commuting and weekend escapes. With its lightweight design and smooth handling, it's perfect for navigating urban streets or exploring new trails.
